analysis: This pass examined only the base-side configuration.md excerpts (lines 486-753) and the single changed line, 685. That line changes the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_SSD_INCREMENTAL_CHECKPOINTS note from 'Not forwarded to LaunchAgents' to 'Forwarded to the launchd provider job'. It is a documentation change. A corresponding code change, presumably adding the key to LaunchAgent.inferencePassthroughEnvKeys, is not in this batch and is unverified. Security relevance is limited under T-041/SEC-035. The variable only disables delta encoding of complete checkpoints. It does not change the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate, TTL, HMAC naming, DBK3 AAD, the KEK or salt scoping. Forwarding an operator-set rollback to installed daemons does not widen the at-rest surface. The operator already controls the provider's environment (TB-003), so this adds no new adversary capability. Integration should confirm that the passthrough allow-list change matches the documentation, i.e., the key is actually forwarded. It should also confirm that delta checkpoints still use the same per-file DEK/KEK and AAD bindings, but that is pre-existing behavior, not part of this change. Other rows in the excerpts are unchanged. No regression was identified.
